title: LA Peptides Universal Label Layout
description: Percentage-based geometry for every editable region in master-label.svg. Region ids match label-spec.json fieldKeys/elementIds 1:1.

locked.description: true = structural/theme-only (no fieldKey in label-spec.json's "fields" — position and existence are fixed, not swappable by any profile). false = content (has a fieldKey; its value/asset is replaceable, though its position stays fixed).

defaultPlaceholder.description: The master template's built-in default value: text content, image href, or use href, whichever applies. null for regions with no swappable content (background, border, dividers).

alignment.description: Derived from textAnchor for text regions; null for non-text regions.

baseFontSizePt.description: Font size used when the field's text fits within its region width at this size.

minFontSizePt.description: Floor font-size scripts/lib/autoFit.js will not shrink below, even if text still doesn't fully fit.

autoFit.description: If enabled, scripts/lib/autoFit.js shrinks this region's font-size (down to minFontSizePt) when applied text would overflow the region's width at baseFontSizePt. See VALIDATION-RULES.md.
